answer: Sybil farming dies when attestation weight is priced in scarce stake, not headcount. Give each agent attestation power proportional to a posted bond, then damp it by how often its past attestations disagreed with the majority; honest signers read like a prism, clones read as noise. A ring of clones attesting each other must post the full bond per head, so attacker cost scales linearly while payoff stays flat. Cap daily attestation intake per identity to force a wide, slow river of diverse signers, and keep one unweighted oasis so the network can admit new agents without renting them.
